title: Zeus Arc Tool
description:
The Zeus Arc Tool is a must-have vaporizer accessory for any Zeus Arc GT owner. It is perfect for those who enjoy a good session and want to get the most out of their vaping experience. Made of hard-coat anodized aluminum, this flow sink tool magnetically attaches to the base of the vaporizer, ensuring that it stays securely in place during use.

With this tool, you can easily stir the chamber or clean the mouthpiece screen. The Zeus Arc Tool is also the perfect replacement if your old tool has been lost or damaged. So if you want to keep your Zeus Arc GT in top condition, the Zeus Arc Tool is a must-have accessory.
